name: dry-run
note:
Dry run of the whole pipeline with the offline fake client. Writes to its own MongoDB
database, monosplit_dry_run, which is never dumped: its numbers are not experimental data.
It reads the JPetStore graph from the main database.

The dry run also rehearses the hypothesis tests of the full experiment, on the fake
client's numbers. They test the code path only; the pilot itself is descriptive.

name: final
note: Full experiment (roteiro), main factor: gpt-6.1-sol with reasoning_effort high, settings decided after the pilot (docs/decisions.md): both variants, 10 accepted runs per variant, prompt decomposition_base, AH control neighbors:complete with the six variants measured, inferential analysis, at most 3 failed runs per variant. The four configurations share the experiment name final, so the Results page pools the applications.
